snippet.title: Stranger Things - Will's Side Quest - Fan Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
Sponsored by Netflix

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119540/Stranger_Things__Wills_Side_Quest/ 

Will's Side Quest is a short first-person adventure/exploration game. Inspired by season 1 and 2 of Stranger Things. Will is home alone for the first time since his disappearing. However, it's not about to be as pleasant as he wanted. It continues the story after the second season but doesn't have any relevance to season 3. The game contains spoilers from season 1-2. 

The game supports both keyboard/mouse and a controller. * Only tested on an Xbox One Controller.

Credits:
This is a fan game made by Dennis Jensen in collaboration with NetFlix.
2D art direction and artwork by Nikki Starostka.
Music by James Opie.
Casting by Sara Secora.
Voice of Will is done by Kevin K. Gomez.
Voice of Eleven and Joyce is done by Sara Secora.

#StrangerThings #Netflix #StrangerThingsNordic
